versions.content: If the data length which shall be transmitted via CanIf_Transmit() does not match possible DLC values (0..8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, 48, or 64), CanTp shall use the next higher valid DLC for transmission with initialization of unused bytes to the value of CANTP_PADDING_BYTE (see ECUC_CanTp_00298 ).
